Counts genuinely render from live relay data on both platforms. I seeded an ephemeral `nak serve` relay with a root note (authored by the signed-in test account) plus 2 replies, 3 reactions, and 1 repost from four separate signed throwaway accounts — a real relay round trip, not synthetic view state. Screenshots (committed at docs/validation/social-bar/{ios,android}/home-feed-social-bar.png, also posted to chirp#32):
- iOS Simulator: row shows counts next to Reply/Repost/Love, no Zap button.
- Android Emulator: row shows "Reply 2 · React 3 · Repost 1", no Zap button.
